title: Everything you need to know 😍 #cookbook #food #recipe #shorts
description:
You’ve been asking what’s in my brand new cookbook!! 📙 So here’s a sneak peak 🙊 I hope you’re as excited as I am 🫶✨

I’m especially proud of this book because it’s such an ‘everyday book’ 🤌 there’s meals in here for every day of the week, including make-ahead breakfasts, 10 minute lunches, low-effort dinners, and dinner party-worthy desserts, all using just 6 main ingredients, so you won’t need a shopping list the length of your arm to make a single recipe 🙌

It’s now available to pre-order! 🥳 Check my bio or just search: Fitwaffle’s Easy 6
